## Power

In Round 1, you can pick either [Phantasm](item_21ed9c3d-7a54-438f-9188-f21fd7a7dbfb) or [Cross-Orbal](item_e567bb63-527f-4c72-8ba1-dc59be1a0dc1). I personally usually go for [Phantasm](item_21ed9c3d-7a54-438f-9188-f21fd7a7dbfb), as it allows me to put out more damage orbs, which means more debuffs. The way you want to use [Phantasm](item_21ed9c3d-7a54-438f-9188-f21fd7a7dbfb) is by walking directly into a chokepoint and then fade back to your team behind cover. This can leave you vulnerable, so do be careful! If this doesn't sound like something you're really comfortable with, go for [Cross-Orbal](item_e567bb63-527f-4c72-8ba1-dc59be1a0dc1) instead, which is always a safer choice. Using [Phantasm](item_21ed9c3d-7a54-438f-9188-f21fd7a7dbfb), you will also have to make sure that your last selected orb is a damage orb, though putting out a healing orb every once in a while before we actually have our debuff items can't hurt.

Another option is [Chain Grasp](item_17b85f3e-1b10-410d-8e02-c7ff61f502a0) and while it doesn't directly help with debuffing, it does give you a lot of Stadium Cash in the early rounds. [Chain Grasp](item_17b85f3e-1b10-410d-8e02-c7ff61f502a0) also works on deployables, such as [Sigma](hero_646d9571-c40a-4403-b6c1-fb67adb6112d)'s barrier, [Winston](hero_a0ebe5ef-69a6-4a8f-9360-7b7fed8bce88)'s barrier and [Junkrat](hero_3ac20f6c-2bce-45f3-998e-9129cc6e5c05)'s trap. It doesn't work on [Reinhardt](hero_a3b6ca2c-6cbd-43dc-bb78-a728e42fba49)'s or [Brigitte](hero_8d4e7c27-fb70-4694-9721-2ecf094ef84a)'s barriers however, so I don't recommend using it when playing against [Reinhardt](hero_a3b6ca2c-6cbd-43dc-bb78-a728e42fba49) especially.

## Items

As for items, I usually go for [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) for survivability, [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) for some [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) and [Charged Plating](item_b8ca58e7-6ae2-40ee-8618-fe2f32315295) for both. We're building entirely around our orbs, so [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) is pretty much essential, but the other items are entirely up to your own preferences. Especially for Round 1, you don't have to focus just on [Ability Power](stat_ability_power). [Shady Spectacles](item_ef9bb72f-a56c-4fb6-a552-5abce0b943d7), [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) or [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) can also be good options. Go for these last two if you picked [Chain Grasp](item_17b85f3e-1b10-410d-8e02-c7ff61f502a0) as your power.

## Power

In Round 2, you get to pick another power and I usually go for [Multiball](item_5d0e4135-f4e1-42fb-991a-417643064560). By Round 2, you should have at least one or both of [Cybervenom](item_210a8582-91ec-4cf3-968a-a443f3a0c505) and [Liquid Nitrogen](item_a8d99526-05a3-4405-babb-b025479b1b98). [Multiball](item_5d0e4135-f4e1-42fb-991a-417643064560) does very little damage, but it'll help with applying these debuffs to as many players as possible. You can also go for [Cross-Orbal](item_e567bb63-527f-4c72-8ba1-dc59be1a0dc1) or [Phantasm](item_21ed9c3d-7a54-438f-9188-f21fd7a7dbfb), depending on which power you picked in Round 1.

## Items

You really just want to build for [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) and there's a lot of flexibility. Depending on how much Stadium Cash you've earned you could go straight into debuffs. In that case, get either [Cybervenom](item_210a8582-91ec-4cf3-968a-a443f3a0c505) or [Liquid Nitrogen](item_a8d99526-05a3-4405-babb-b025479b1b98). I usually go for [Cybervenom](item_210a8582-91ec-4cf3-968a-a443f3a0c505) first, as it's cheaper and massively shuts down comps with high amounts of sustain, but you can really go either way. To further help with applying your debuffs, [Smart Orbs](item_47f5985c-9b63-40d2-938b-63a22154b9be) is a must-have. However, these items are expensive and if you don't have a lot of Stadium Cash or you don't feel like the debuffs are worth the Stadium Cash just yet, go for some cheap items that give a whole bunch of [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) instead. Examples include [Custom Stock](item_17d633af-8bcc-4893-b865-be0a7bc66fe2), [Energized Bracers](item_f83a1d9e-91f8-4d2c-bd62-c673b8d9fd2e) and [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56). I like [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56) and its [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) a lot, as it'll help with both of Moira's cooldowns. A lower Fade cooldown can in turn help with putting out more [Phantasm](item_21ed9c3d-7a54-438f-9188-f21fd7a7dbfb) orbs. [Smart Orbs](item_47f5985c-9b63-40d2-938b-63a22154b9be) is also great, but I usually save it for when I have at least one of the debuff items.

Tip: Items like [Nano Cola](item_79b22609-8046-4a8a-a5a2-bb49cd7e11c6) and [Champion's Kit](item_8682f8c7-8811-439b-8d50-fa81cd43ddce) are not at all cost-effective and should generally be avoided in the early rounds. Only use them when your item slots would be full otherwise. For example, [Nano Cola](item_79b22609-8046-4a8a-a5a2-bb49cd7e11c6) gives 20% [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) and costs 6,000 Stadium Cash. In its place you could get [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) and [Custom Stock](item_17d633af-8bcc-4893-b865-be0a7bc66fe2) for 20% [Ability Power](stat_ability_power), 10 health and 5% [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) instead, which only costs you 4,750 Stadium Cash. On top of that, unlike most Epic items, [Champion's Kit](item_8682f8c7-8811-439b-8d50-fa81cd43ddce) does not offer any sort of utility.

round_upgrades.notes: Unless you get a good orb bounce, Smart Orbs will actually do more damage than Champion's Kit

## Power

In Round 3, you can pick either [Cross-Orbal](item_e567bb63-527f-4c72-8ba1-dc59be1a0dc1), [Multiball](item_5d0e4135-f4e1-42fb-991a-417643064560) or [Phantasm](item_21ed9c3d-7a54-438f-9188-f21fd7a7dbfb), depending on which one you don't have yet. [Cross-Orbal](item_e567bb63-527f-4c72-8ba1-dc59be1a0dc1) is great for some extra sustain, since we're building for [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) anyway. You still want your main orb and thus [Multiball](item_5d0e4135-f4e1-42fb-991a-417643064560) orbs to be damage orbs though, because [Multiball](item_5d0e4135-f4e1-42fb-991a-417643064560) is only good for applying debuffs.

## Items

Depending on your Stadium Cash, you should be able to afford [Cybervenom](item_210a8582-91ec-4cf3-968a-a443f3a0c505), [Liquid Nitrogen](item_a8d99526-05a3-4405-babb-b025479b1b98) and [Smart Orbs](item_47f5985c-9b63-40d2-938b-63a22154b9be). If you can already afford it, get [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) as well. Fill the rest of your slots with cheaper items that give [Ability Power](stat_ability_power).

## Items

I think almost any build should have at least one item to help with survivability, so I usually go for [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8). If you can already afford it, get [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e) or [Biotech Maximizer](item_01c6dcb3-d2e2-4c57-bd21-61d7b8f939c4) as well. My preference is for [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e), as it gives more [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) and has a guaranteed [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) for both your orbs and your fade, which in turn allows you to put out both more and stronger [Phantasm](item_21ed9c3d-7a54-438f-9188-f21fd7a7dbfb) orbs. If you have even more leftover Stadium Cash, get [Extendrils](item_138e73a2-6915-4ffc-bd89-029a85bf94b8) or fill the rest of your slots with cheap items that give [Ability Power](stat_ability_power), like [Nano Cola](item_79b22609-8046-4a8a-a5a2-bb49cd7e11c6) and [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418).

This is the final build, but there's a ton of flexibility depending on your own preferences and playstyle.

## Power

The final power is entirely up to you. I think [Chain Grasp](item_17b85f3e-1b10-410d-8e02-c7ff61f502a0) is a decent option if you're more focused on doing damage. [Optimal Overflow](item_9d85ca48-b27a-435a-8ef9-247440e0f97d) on the other hand is a great option if you're healing a majority of the time, though I think this power works best in combination with a bunch of [Attack Speed](stat_attack_speed) to activate it faster, so an item like [Alternative Energy](item_c3e816b3-9c39-4528-9578-e3fa610b6cc6) works well with it. [Voidhoppers](item_d4ce0c76-2500-40d6-b066-dca303be097f) can be great if you need a cleanse for any negative effects that are bothering your team, such as [Ashe](hero_37b42a2d-a82d-4a22-9df2-4c812c873b54)'s dynamite or [Ana](hero_f1aee6cf-704f-455f-a100-ec882ebbe000)'s anti-heal. This power also grants your allies Overhealth equal to 20% of your max Life, which should be quite a lot by Round 5, as your health scales with the amount of Stadium Cash you have. [Destruction’s Divide](item_cb7be5fa-0098-4a3c-bf62-efb3738a97e6) is a great option if you want your ult to be more impactful, but do keep in mind that this power does nothing for you outside of your ult. [Catalytic Crystal](item_3e3f4f77-cdf8-4dda-a5b0-2fb9390aefc4) is a good choice when using this power. [Ethereal Excision](item_a2359da3-1aa5-406f-a82f-4a0bd66266ac) is another power to consider if you're more damage-focused, but I feel is more suited to Weapon or Survival builds. Another thing I want to note is that from my limited testing in the Practice Range, [Deconstruction](item_cc8c46cc-b4a3-4c0f-aeb6-f7837e0e8e7c) does not seem to work with [Moira](hero_7fb6ff1e-a193-40c0-bd0a-25c1928fbaed)'s orbs, so I would avoid this one in an orb build. My personal preference is for [Chain Grasp](item_17b85f3e-1b10-410d-8e02-c7ff61f502a0) and [Voidhoppers](item_d4ce0c76-2500-40d6-b066-dca303be097f).

## Items

As for items, you should be able to afford [Extendrils](item_138e73a2-6915-4ffc-bd89-029a85bf94b8) now. [Cybervenom](item_210a8582-91ec-4cf3-968a-a443f3a0c505), [Liquid Nitrogen](item_a8d99526-05a3-4405-babb-b025479b1b98), [Extendrils](item_138e73a2-6915-4ffc-bd89-029a85bf94b8) and [Smart Orbs](item_47f5985c-9b63-40d2-938b-63a22154b9be) are essential in any debuff orb build in my opinion. [Extendrils](item_138e73a2-6915-4ffc-bd89-029a85bf94b8) in combination with [Smart Orbs](item_47f5985c-9b63-40d2-938b-63a22154b9be) will make your debuffs constant. The reason why I don't usually go for [Extendrils](item_138e73a2-6915-4ffc-bd89-029a85bf94b8) earlier on is because it's not very cost-effective, especially compared to something like [Smart Orbs](item_47f5985c-9b63-40d2-938b-63a22154b9be). [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) and [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e) could be replaced with any of the optional items listed, depending on your personal preferences or Stadium Cash, but I think both items have a rightful place in a debuff orb build. [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) gives some great survivability and has syngergy with [Phantasm](item_21ed9c3d-7a54-438f-9188-f21fd7a7dbfb) and [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e) helps put out a ton more debuff orbs.
